title: LLM Inference API with Batched GPU Serving
summary: Design the public API and dispatcher in front of a pool of GPU model replicas that expose a fixed-latency batch call, covering batching policy, load balancing and admission control, KV-cache and prefix-cache arithmetic, real-time/offline isolation, and a follow-up scheduling policy for a large model that needs a whole 8-GPU pool against a small model that needs one GPU.
